from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityDegreeRecord(BaseModel):
    """One university's Bachelor's degree count from a single CDS report."""
    university: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    bachelors_degrees: int | None = Field(description="Number of Bachelor's degrees awarded in the reported period")
    period_start: str | None = Field(description="The start date of the reporting period")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="Which section of the document contains this data, e.g. 'B3'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_degree_records: list[UniversityDegreeRecord]
